title: AgentKthx Plugin Manifest
description: Validation schema for AgentKthx plugin.json manifests, specification version 0.2. Dual-form: AgentKthx-specific fields may appear at top level (v0.1 legacy, deprecated) or under extensions['org.vts-tech.agentkthx'] (v0.2 canonical). Unknown top-level fields are permitted in v0.2 (warn-and-ignore); the schema is planned to close in v0.3.

name.description: Unique plugin identifier. MUST match the plugin directory name.

description.description: Short description of what the plugin does.

author.description: Author name, or structured author object (Agent Plugins form).

license.description: SPDX license identifier RECOMMENDED. Validated warn-only by the client.

extensions.description: Client-specific manifest data keyed by reverse-domain extension namespace.

display_name.description: LEGACY top-level form (deprecated in v0.2). Canonical location: extensions['org.vts-tech.agentkthx'].display_name

type.description: LEGACY top-level form (deprecated in v0.2). Canonical location: extensions['org.vts-tech.agentkthx'].type

entrypoint.description: LEGACY top-level form (deprecated in v0.2). Python module inside the plugin directory providing register()/unregister().

depends.description: LEGACY top-level form (deprecated in v0.2). Hard dependencies by plugin name.

optional_depends.description: LEGACY top-level form (deprecated in v0.2). Soft dependencies.

defaults.description: ENV_VAR -> default value. Values MAY reference ${PLUGIN_ROOT} and ${PLUGIN_DATA}.

backends.description: Backend name -> 'module.ClassPath' relative to the plugin directory. Classes MUST subclass BaseBackend.

cli_flags.description: Flag name -> list of allowed values, e.g. {"--backend": ["bitnet"]}.

tools.description: Tool names the plugin registers into the core ToolRegistry.

additionalProperties.description: 'module.function' path relative to the plugin directory.

agentkthx.description: Comma-separated semver comparisons, ANDed. Warn-only enforcement.

compatibility.description: LEGACY top-level form (deprecated in v0.2). Legacy key 'agentnova' is accepted as an alias of 'agentkthx' with a deprecation warning.
